definitions.explanation: Humble form of 会う, used when the speaker is meeting someone of higher status.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{目|め}にかかりたいのですが。
examples.english: I would like to meet with the president.
examples.notes: Requesting a meeting with someone important

examples.japanese: お{目|め}にかかれて⟦{光栄|こうえい}→光栄：19436_kouei⟧です。
examples.english: It's an honor to meet you.
examples.notes: Polite greeting when meeting someone distinguished

examples.japanese: ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦うち→内：01328_uchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{目|め}にかかりたいです。
examples.english: I hope to see you again soon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{目|め}にかかる⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧です。
examples.english: It's been a long time since I last met with you, professor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{目|め}にかかれる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみにしています→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧。
examples.english: I heard I'll be able to meet the department head at next week's meeting, and I'm very much looking forward to it.

notes:
お{目|め}にかかる is the humble (⟦{謙譲語|けんじょうご}→謙譲語：15869_kenjougo⟧) form of ⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: お{目|め}にかかる

KEIGO SYSTEM:
- ⟦{会|あ}う→会う：00482_au⟧ (neutral): to meet
- お{目|め}にかかる (humble): I meet [superior]
- お{会|あ}いになる (honorific): [superior] meets

USAGE:
- Used when the speaker is the one doing the meeting
- Shows respect by lowering oneself
- Common in business and formal situations
- かかる is written in hiragana, not as ⟦{掛|か}かる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧
- The お is part of the fixed expression
